postal_system.full_code_rule: Treat a unit postcode as a Royal Mail allocation to a large user or a group of usually adjacent delivery addresses. It is not an official boundary.
postal_system.outward_code_rule: Area and district prefixes are coarse routing geography and cannot select a premise or building.
postal_system.ons_coordinate_rule: ONSPD coordinates and best-fit administrative links are statistical reference evidence, not exact delivery points or postal boundaries.
postal_system.model_geometry_rule: Voronoi, buffers, alpha shapes, learned boundaries, and AGID cell unions are derived candidate geometry only.
postal_system.northern_ireland_rule: BT records and artifacts use a separate Land and Property Services rights gate, especially for commercial reuse.

exception_classes.rule: Preserve all source-backed delivery points; never infer house numbers or buildings from the postcode centroid.
A postcode can belong to one high-volume recipient. Keep it non-areal unless independent geometry exists.
Keep PO Box and BFPO records non-spatial unless a separately licensed public facility relation exists.
Pin source points, clipping boundary, algorithm, parameters, digest, and time. Never label the result as a Royal Mail boundary.
Northern Ireland BT data stays in a separately reviewable license partition and cannot inherit Great Britain reuse rights.
Retain termination and reuse history with separate valid and known times; never overwrite an old location.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release, digest, terms reference, attribution, geographic scope, and transformation method.
Royal Mail assignment, ONS statistics, UPRN point, building geometry, derived postcode surface, and AGID index remain separate.
Live, terminated, reused, and no-grid-reference records are explicit and time-versioned.
Postcode, address fields, delivery-point identifier, UPRN, and building relation agree on one source-backed path; conflicts remain alternatives.
Geometry is valid, bounded, clipped, versioned, and evaluated against independent holdout addresses.
The intended internal, public, or commercial artifact is allowed by recorded LPS terms.
No recipient, occupant, customer record, phone, delivery instruction, credential, or private unit assertion is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
